# Sentric

> Open-source Solana wallet intelligence for AI agents. REST API and read-only MCP tools. MIT-licensed TypeScript.

Sentric provides scored wallet swaps, same-direction consensus and optional social context. It does not execute trades. Conviction is a heuristic, not a probability of profit. Watchlist labels are operator-supplied; unknown historical performance is not represented as measured data.

## Reference
- [Integration guide](https://sentric.sh/docs/): setup, MCP tools, payments, methodology and limitations.
- [OpenAPI](https://sentric.sh/openapi.json): routes, filters and response schemas.
- [Complete reference](https://sentric.sh/llms-full.txt): text documentation for agent retrieval.
- [Source](https://github.com/brandononchain/sentric): server, tests, MCP client and examples.

## Runtime
- [Health](https://sentric.sh/health): check provider availability and freshness.
- [Free preview](https://sentric.sh/v1/signals/preview): at most seven recent signals.

Full signal access uses x402 v2 when configured; development bypass is local-only and forbidden in production. An unavailable service is not evidence that no wallets are trading.
